thread:
liam (design): Quick design check — updated tooltips and microcopy for autoscale presets + SLO slider. focus: clarity when burst is enabled and the contrast of the little info icon.
aya (product): dropping in — can you call out the specific places you changed? small screens + keyboard nav are the two concern areas for PM.
nate (eng): I skimmed the figma. main runtime question: are the tooltips static text or we render them server-side (so translations sync)?
liam (design): they are static i18n keys for now. proposal text below — want UX + a11y review before we send to i18n.
liam (design): Tooltip A (burst pill): "Burst capacity: temporary GPU boost to handle short traffic spikes. Costs may increase during bursts." 
liam (design): Tooltip B (min/max): "Min / Max instances — the autoscaler will keep usage between these values. Set max to cap spend."
liam (design): Slider label: "Latency SLO (ms) — soft target for request latency; guardrails will try to maintain this but may adjust under heavy load."
ruth (a11y): quick notes — contrast: the info icon on dark mode is currently #6b7280 which fails AA on 12px icons. Needs higher contrast or a 1px outline.
ruth (a11y): keyboard: tooltips must be dismissible with Esc and focus should return to the trigger. Also aria-describedby should reference the tooltip content.
aya (product): microcopy question — do we want to surface "Costs may increase" in the pill? that's pretty scary for users; maybe soften.
liam (design): alternatives:
- "Costs may increase during bursts" (current)
- "Temporary capacity; additional charges may apply"
- "Short-term boost; may affect billing"
aya (product): My pick is option 2 — less alarming but still clear.
nate (eng): implementation note: adding long tooltip text will change layout on mobile. I can cap tooltip width to 320px and make it scrollable.
liam (design): ok cap 320px is fine. Add a CTA link at the bottom: "Learn how burst affects billing" => opens docs.
ruth (a11y): CTA must be keyboard focusable and screen-reader text should be "Learn how burst affects billing — opens in new tab" (use rel and target attrs properly).
liam (design): copy for CTA: "Learn how burst affects billing (opens in docs)" — thoughts?
aya (product): remove the parenthetical. use screen-reader disclosure only.
liam (design): updated text: "Learn how burst affects billing"
nate (eng): small perf nit: avoid showing tooltip for hover on touch devices. show only on tap/focus.
liam (design): agreed.
liam (design): also added a microcopy for the SLO guardrail hover state: "Guardrail active: autoscaler will prefer latency over cost within these bounds." 
aya (product): hmm wording a tad opaque — maybe "Guardrail active: autoscaler prioritizes keeping latency within the SLO; this may temporarily increase cost." 
ruth (a11y): prefer explicit language about behavior. also ensure this state has a clear visible indicator (badge or color) and we don't rely on colour alone.
liam (design): badge idea: small pill "guardrail" with aria-live updates when it becomes active.
nate (eng): aria-live is fine but heavy — we should debounce state changes to avoid screen reader spam. 1s debounce ok?
ruth (a11y): yes debounce, and make updates polite (aria-live=\"polite\").
liam (design): copy for the guardrail tooltip (final attempt): "Guardrail active — autoscaler is prioritizing Latency SLO. Additional capacity may be used to meet targets." 
aya (product): sounds good. can we surface estimated short-term cost impact? even a rough note like "estimated +10%" would be helpful but tricky to calculate.
nate (eng): we can show a banded estimate if we have recent perf/cost data — but let's ship without it and iterate once telemetry is in.
liam (design): ok leave estimate out for MVP.
liam (design): last UX ask — contrast and hit target size for the little icon (info / guardrail) needs upgrades. can we standardize to 18px tap target and 44px accessible hit area?
ruth (a11y): 44px hit area is good. provide visually hidden label: "More info about autoscale" for the info icon.
nate (eng): will implement: 18px visible icon + 24px padding overlay to reach 44px total.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/ui-tooltips v1.4 -> will be available in ~12m
aya (product): awesome — can reviewers check staging and reply with any final tweaks?
liam (design): thanks all — I'll update Figma with the final copy/aria notes and ping again in 30m. :thumbsup:
